project_title: AI Autonomous Regression Testing Platform (Enterprise QA SaaS)
context_type: DASHBOARDS & ADMIN PANELS / ENTERPRISE SAAS APP

theme.style_archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / HIGH CONTRAST TECHNICAL PRECISION
theme.description: Tactical dark UI anchored in Obsidian Zinc (#09090B) with high-density cardless/subtle bordered panels, electric cyan (#00F0FF) and emerald green (#10B981) action triggers, and strict technical hierarchy.

font_genres.headings: Cabinet Grotesk / Outfit / Plus Jakarta Sans (Prohibited from using Inter for Headings)

hierarchy.code_snippet: font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm bg-zinc-900/80 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-zinc-800

rules: Never use Inter for Main and Sub-headings.
Always apply tracking-tight or tracking-tighter on headlines > 24px.
Overline labels MUST be uppercase + text-xs + tracking-[0.2em].
Maintain a strong hierarchy gap without exceeding text-5xl on hero headers.
Never use pure black #000000 or un-tinted gray #808080. Always tint dark neutrals with cool zinc or navy slate.
ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover states (e.g. hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white).
DO NOT use full-screen dark gradients. Surface textures + solid structural borders are required.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds on headers, dropdowns, or overlays. Always use backdrop blur with non-transparent surface opacity (e.g. bg-zinc-950/85 backdrop-blur-md).

grids_and_layout.dashboard_grid_protocol: MODE B: High Density Grid (12-column layout on desktop)
grids_and_layout.card_style: Cardless or subtle 1px border (#27272A), 8px border-radius, dark surface (#121215), with direct data visibility.
grids_and_layout.subgrid_rules: Direct grid children only. Motion wrappers must carry grid span classes.
grids_and_layout.alignment: Mobile-first responsive layout with left-aligned dense telemetry tables and right/top CTA action clusters.

micro_interactions: Card hover subtle elevation with highlight border transition
Status badge pulse for active regression runs
Accordion / drawer expansion for trace execution trees
motion_and_interactions.transition_rules: NEVER use transition: all. Explicitly list transition properties (e.g., transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.2s).

code_editor_visuals.description: IDE code execution screen for live browser testing and regression analysis
Data structure and requirement specification code trace

key_views_to_implement: 1. Dashboard (KPI tiles, active regression jobs, model status, recent test failures, run pass-rate graphs)
2. Projects List & Project Configuration (GitHub repo linking, environment URLs, branch triggers, build webhooks)
3. Document Management (Upload & parse plan.md, scenario.md, functionalities-scenario.md, render formatted markdown editor & tree outline)
4. AI Provider Management (Gateway configuration for Anthropic Claude 3.7, OpenAI GPT-4.5/o3-mini, Google Gemini 2.0 Pro, API Key vault, status probe)
5. Model Registry & Capabilities (Model capability matrix, token context limits, cost per 1M tokens, default fallback rules)
6. Model Assignment (Granular assignment at Org, Project, and Task levels e.g. Code Analysis -> Claude 3.7, Browser Execution -> GPT-4o)
7. Token Usage & Cost Dashboards (Historical token usage line chart, per-model breakdown, cost per project, monthly spend vs budget limits)
8. Budget Management (Hard/Soft budget limits, email/slack alert thresholds, auto-pause automated runs on threshold breach)
9. Application Intelligence & Code Analysis (Repository structural scan, API endpoint extraction, state machine mapping)
10. Testing Workspace & Live Browser Testing (Step-by-step agent execution trajectory, real-time log stream, screenshot evidence viewer, live DOM tree inspector)
11. Test Case Repository & Regression Execution (Test case creation, suite tagging, trigger regression execution run, diff-first run comparison)
12. Defect Intelligence & Evidence Repository (Semantic failure mode clustering, trace-linked debugging, auto-generated GitHub issue creator, video/screenshot evidence)
13. Reports, Audit Logs & Settings (Export PDF/JSON test summary, full system audit log with filter by user/agent action)
instructions_to_main_agent.file_structure_guidelines: Use standard React JavaScript (.js) files inside /app/frontend/src/. Ensure proper imports using '@/' path alias where configured.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_requirement: CRITICAL: Every interactive element, navigation item, button, input, tab, card, and metric container MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="project-card-run-button").

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid generic centered white cards with soft shadows. Create high-density, rich developer-grade panels with crisp borders, subtle dark glows, clear typography hierarchy, and precise metric badges.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never render empty or fully transparent header/dropdown panels over dynamic content.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_contrast_mandate: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards against dark background surfaces (#09090B / #121215).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.micro_interactions: Every interactive button and selector must have hover, active, and focus states.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for all action feedback (e.g., 'GitHub repository connected successfully', 'Regression run queued').
